gstHstCredit.unavailableReason: July 2027 to June 2028 payment amounts (2026 base year) were not yet published on the CRA payment-amounts page as of the data access date. The calculator applies the latest published CGEB parameters to 2026 income in projected current-rules mode (no indexation of unpublished amounts).

canadaWorkersBenefit.timingNote: Refundable tax credit for this tax year (line 45300). Dollar maxima and phase-out starts are from CRA indexation for 2026. Phase-in base ($3,000), phase-in rate (27%), and phase-out rate (15%) are the structural Schedule 6 rates published for 2025; the 2026 Schedule 6 PDF was not yet posted when this data file was authored.
canadaWorkersBenefit.excludedProvincesNote: Quebec, Alberta, and Nunavut use province/territory-specific Schedule 6 parameters. Those jurisdictions are not modeled here.
canadaWorkersBenefit.disabilitySupplementNote: CWB disability supplement is excluded. Eligibility requires Disability Tax Credit approval, which this calculator does not collect.

canadaChildBenefit.unavailableReason: July 2027 to June 2028 CCB amounts (2026 base year) were not yet published on the CRA CCB payment-amounts / how-much pages as of the data access date. The calculator applies the latest published CCB parameters to 2026 income in projected current-rules mode (no indexation of unpublished amounts).

provincialPrograms.note: Provincial and territorial income-tested benefits are not modeled in this version.
